In the past, the rich used to pay higher taxes.  

Now, the government pays the rich interest on a swelling debt, caused largely by lower taxes on the rich. 

It's a big switcheroo that we need to talk about if we're going to talk about the national debt.

posts.text:
Social Security turns 91 today, but thanks to rising inequality it may not live to see many more birthdays.

I used to be a Social Security trustee — here's how we can fix it without cutting benefits or raising the retirement age.
posts.summary: Proposes taxing income over $400k to guarantee Social Security solvency and expand benefits
posts.quote:
Social Security turns 91 today, but thanks to rising inequality it may not live to see many more birthdays.

I used to be a Social Security trustee — here's how we can fix it without cutting benefits or raising the retirement age.

posts.text:
If all income in excess of $400,000 were subject to the Social Security payroll tax, Social Security’s solvency would be guaranteed forever. We could also expand Social Security benefits.

There’s no reason even to consider reducing Social Security benefits or raising the age of eligibility.
